dataList.title:
Los Mariachis
流浪乐队
dataList.teller:
Mariachi Novato
新来的乐队成员
dataList.content:
You want me to do that…?
你要我上……？

The child’s eyes quivered. His skin went pale, and his well-furbished mustache wriggled like a caterpillar.
这孩子的瞳孔颤抖着，脸上的皮肤变得苍白，擦得油亮的胡子像毛毛虫一样扭动着。

dataList.title:
Los Mariachis
流浪乐队
dataList.teller:
Mariachi Alegre
欢快的乐队成员
dataList.content:
El jefe… he’s feeling uneasy. It’s all up to you to cheer him up, aye, novato?
老大他……他最近感觉不大好。现在得靠你来给他打气了，明白了吗，新来的？

Another child softly comforted him.
另一个孩子在柔声安慰他。

All the other children had their eyes fixed on the one they called “jefe” or “boss”, who was holding maracas in trembling hands.
其他的孩子们都盯着那个被他们称为“老大”的孩子，后者的手不停颤抖着，抓着两把沙锤。

dataList.title:
Los Mariachis
流浪乐队
dataList.teller:
Mariachi Vivaz
活泼的乐队成员
dataList.content:
You see, novato… this is like a rite of passage.
你看，新来的……这就跟成年礼差不多。

dataList.title:
Los Mariachis
流浪乐队
dataList.teller:
Mariachi Alegre
欢快的乐队成员
dataList.content:
Sip, that’s right. It’s… something all true purveyors of joy oughta experience to be un verdadero mariachi.
对，没错。这是……成为一个真正能传递快乐的人，成为流浪乐队的一员必不可少的一步。

The appointed child’s face was so pale, it was starting to take on a shade of lead.
被点名上前的孩子脸色惨白，甚至接近于铅色的阴影。

dataList.title:
Los Mariachis
流浪乐队
dataList.teller:
Mariachi Novato
新来的乐队成员
dataList.content:
But… I’ve heard the stories. If I say that to our jefe, Sinclair…
但是……我听说了，如果我对辛克莱老大说出那句话……

dataList.title:
Los Mariachis
流浪乐队
dataList.teller:
Mariachi Alegre
欢快的乐队成员
dataList.content:
Sip, your head will go pop.
对，你的脑袋会“嘣”地一下爆开。

dataList.title:
Los Mariachis
流浪乐队
dataList.teller:
Mariachi Vivaz
活泼的乐队成员
dataList.content:
For sure, un cráneo explosivo.
没错，你的脑袋会爆开。

“What did I just say!” The child angrily argues, but the other children shake their heads and say the same thing:
“我刚刚说什么来着！”那孩子愤怒地嚷嚷起来，但是其他孩子都摇了摇头，异口同声地说：

dataList.title:
Los Mariachis
流浪乐队
dataList.teller:
Mariachi Alegre
欢快的乐队成员
dataList.content:
…We all went through it once.
……我们曾都经历过这关。

The child let out a long sigh after that.
闻言，那孩子长长地叹了一口气。

Then… he realized that there was no way out of it.
然后……他就意识到这事避无可避了。

The child carefully opened his mouth and spoke to the boss…
那孩子小心翼翼地开口，对他的老大说……

dataList.title:
Los Mariachis
流浪乐队
dataList.teller:
Mariachi Novato
新来的乐队成员
dataList.content:
Um, B—Boss… P-Prepare the pañata party pl—
呃，老、老大……请……请准备开始皮纳塔派对——

Before that sentence could finish…
这句话还没说完……

Shaka.
沙咔。

A wee spout of blood gushed out of the head of the child who mentioned “pañata”.
刚刚提到“皮纳塔”的孩子头上飙出一小股血。

dataList.title:
Los Mariachis
流浪乐队
dataList.teller:
Mariachi Alegre
欢快的乐队成员
dataList.content:
Mhm. Bien hecho, novato.
嗯。干得不错，新人。

dataList.title:
Los Mariachis
流浪乐队
dataList.teller:
Mariachi Vivaz
活泼的乐队成员
dataList.content:
Sip, the boss… has entered boss mode.
是啊，老大……开启老大模式了。

The rest of the children scratched themselves on the backs of their respective heads as they watched the fainted child with proud eyes.
其余的孩子们挠着自己的后脑勺，用骄傲的眼神看着地上昏倒的孩子。

From the looks of things… it seems to have reminded of them of their own experiences.
看起来……这好像让他们想起了自己的经历。
